sources.title: ouro_kronii_(casual)
sources.excerpt:
The 3rd [[official alternate costume|costume]] of [[hololive English|hololive EN]]'s [[Ouro Kronii]].

It consists of a [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[turtleneck]] [[white shirt]] with [[shoulder cutout]]s (although some fans depict it as a [[sleeveless turtleneck]] with [[detached sleeves]] due to her being able to swap her top for a sleeveless turtleneck), [[high-waist pants|high-waist]] [[blue pants|blue]] [[jeans]] that she can swap her jeans with a pair of [[blue shorts|blue]] [[dolphin shorts]], a [[brown coat|brown]] [[trench coat]], and [[white shoes|white]] [[high heels]]. She now has a pair of [[ear piercing]]s on her right ear and her [[halo]] is now much smaller and is styled after an electronic clock. She also has an optional [[handbag]] with a [[Boros (Ouro Kronii)|]] [[keyring]] [[bag charm]]. 

Her [[official alternate hairstyle|official hairstyle]] with this attire is [[long hair]] is [[hime cut]]-esque  with [[blunt bangs|blunt]] [[center-flap bangs]] and long [[sidelocks]] with [[blunt ends]], with her [[hair intakes]] being placed closer together.
